title: Add Dialogs to Change Animation Track path

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4847

In the AnimationPlayer, left clicking the path name allows the user to type in a new path.
This change adds a right-click menu with the following options:
- Change Target Node - Opens a SceneTreeDialog to select a new node, changing the target node to it
- Change Target Property - Opens a PropertySelector dialog, showing properties on the target node. Selecting one changes the property to that one.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/91d80326-41fc-4ba0-9982-2a284ee5dab1)


Currently neither dialog have type filters, I previously considered adding them, but that came with some pain points:
- Two nodes of different types can have the same property, like Sprite2D.modulate and Sprite3D.modulate.
- Tracks don't have types, keyframes have types. So a filter on the property selector didn't seem intuitive.
- The current implementation of changing the path allows the user to pass an incorrect path, putting X's on the keyframes. It might be a good idea to let the user deal with it similarly.

I'm still somewhat new to the codebase, so it's possible I might've organized some things incorrectly. Although I tried to line things up with how the other menu/dialogs were set up.

Notably this doesn't add any right click functionality to the group of tracks for the node, that could be an interesting follow up PR.

I also considered adding a "Copy to new Target Node" but getting UndoRedo to work with that + trying to reuse some copy/paste code was a pain. Apparently you can't pass structs like TrackClipboard items into it because they're not variants.🤔 

Sidenote to: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56074
I notice the right clicking on the keyframes on the left side of the divider, while mousing over a keyframe, still does not register as a keyframe right click. (As an existing issue) This means it will open the menu added in this PR. Not sure if I should make an effort to fix it in this PR or treat it as a separate existing issue.
